correctness.rationale: The 1-based odd-part definition yields sixteen-bit blocks W_j=1101100 e_j 1100100 b_j with alternating e_j and terminal b_{m−1}=1. Reconstructed greedy suffix-universality recurrence r(i)=1+r(1+max(N0(i),N1(i))) where both letters exist. Directly inspected source checker supplies all four 17-entry local rank profiles and complete six-step rank-drop path alternatives; both choices land at next-block offset 1−b_j, so all blocks concatenate independently. Independent brute paperfolding construction and direct scattered-subsequence enumeration for k=4 and 5 reproduced universality 6m, exact SAS language and count 2^(m+1). The proof for all k rests on universal finite transfer rows, not tests only through k=8.
